proposed_global_claims.statement: At a generically ramified boundary divisor where a source coordinate has pole order m>0, a finite coefficient-field extension and formal uniformizer change put that coordinate in the form x=s^(-m); the coefficients c_j of y with j<m+e are constant, and the exact primitive equation forces the resonant coefficient c_m to vanish.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: No formal parameter or Laurent coefficient is globally algebraized.

proposed_global_claims.statement: If positive pole orders m,n and leading coefficients a,b satisfy n a' b-m a b'=0, then after gcd reduction there is a rational conormal section h and constants alpha,beta with a=alpha h^(m/d) and b=beta h^(n/d), including the corresponding divisor proportionality.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: The rational conormal section is not asserted to be an affine unit or a global trivialization.

proposed_global_claims.statement: In the normalized parameter s, the complete Jacobian Laurent recursion is d c_(m+r)=-beta_r/m: every higher coefficient exists exactly when its rational differential beta_r is exact, while the primitive recursion determines all nonresonant radial coefficients and leaves only the order-zero resonance.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: No finite global algebraization or uniform valuation bound is proved.

proposed_global_claims.statement: For a generically ramified boundary divisor at which at least one source coordinate has a pole, the pullback of P dQ to the normalization of the reduced target branch is an exact rational differential.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: No general one-boundary exclusion, conductor descent, algebraization, polynomial realization, or bounded-weight conclusion.

proposed_global_claims.statement: The normalized primitive R with dR=P dQ is regular on the affine normalized target branch, and its possible descent to a singular target coordinate ring is measured by the finite class [R] in Abar/A_C.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: A nonzero conductor class is not automatically a contradiction without a separate target-descent requirement.

proposed_global_claims.statement: A ramified pole-supported one-boundary Keller normalization cannot have a reduced target branch whose normalized Liouville class [P dQ] is nonzero; in particular, the smooth non-toric branch P(P-1)Q-1=0 is excluded.

The present pole-order, leading common-power, Laurent, and conductor data do not determine a bound on the grading defect of the primitive pole weight because global polynomial support and leading-layer cancellations remain uncontrolled.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: This is not a counterexample to a qualifying-weight theorem and does not consume defect five.

proposed_global_claims.statement: Explicit arbitrary-index toric controls and a non-toric Liouville-exact near-model satisfy the displayed all-order Jacobian and primitive identities, but their first failed Keller condition is polynomial realization.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: The controls are not polynomial Keller pairs or counterexamples.

proposed_global_claims.statement: For the Liouville-exact non-toric pole-supported class, prove a higher differential or conductor obstruction, rule out polynomial algebraization, or control all global Newton/Rees layers strongly enough to obtain a qualifying weight.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: No finite list or uniform bound on ramification, poles, conductor, punctures, genus, or branch multiplicity is proved.

proposed_graph_nodes.statement: Ramified pole-supported one-boundary data force normalized branch Liouville exactness and exclude the Liouville-nonexact subclass.
Eliminate or polynomially realize the Liouville-exact non-toric formal survivor and control its global polynomial support.
